description: Items to buy from Amazon for the active receiver. `items` is the required list and must fit the budget; `recommended_extras` reduce build risk but are not fitted parts. Lab parts come from new_allowed_components.json, which also lists the already purchased XIAO RP2350 and HiLetgo ADS1256 modules. receiver_design/verify.py checks that every required item is used in receiver_design/bom.csv and that the totals match.

items.role: Receiver gain stage (MOD2): 3.2 nV/rtHz maximum input noise, gain set to 100 by R1
items.listing_title: AD8421 Precision Instrument Amplifier, Micro-Signal Millivolt/Microvolt Voltage Amplifier Module, Single-Ended/Differential
items.notes: Ships from a third-party seller; delivery to the US was quoted as Oct 21-26 on 2026-10-09. Needs a +/-4 V to +/-16 V dual supply. Remove its input RFI parts before use (receiver_design/assembly.md).

items.part: SMA male to Dupont male coaxial test lead
items.role: Cable W1 from the module's OUT SMA jack to the anti-aliasing filter
items.listing_title: XMSJSIY SMA Male to Dupont Wire Coaxial Coax Test Leads Cable Connector Adapter Extension Wire (Red+Black)
items.notes: Two Dupont leads (red and black). Confirm with a meter which one reaches the SMA center pin (signal); the other is the shield (GND).

items.role: Battery leads W2 and W3 to the module's V+ / GND / V- screw terminal
items.listing_title: SDTC Tech 6 Pcs 9V Battery Snap Connector
items.notes: Two of the six are used.

items.role: Module supply BT1 (+9 V) and BT2 (-9 V)
items.listing_title: EBL 9V Batteries 2-Pack, Reliable Long Lasting Alkaline 9V Battery
items.notes: Requirements are checked down to 6.0 V per battery.

recommended_extras.role: Spare MOD2, in case removing the input RFI parts damages the first board or the chip proves not to be a genuine AD8421
recommended_extras.listing_title: AD8421 Precision Instrument Amplifier, Micro-Signal Millivolt/Microvolt Voltage Amplifier Module, Single-Ended/Differential
recommended_extras.notes: Same listing as MOD2. Order both at once; the third-party seller's delivery takes about two weeks.

recommended_extras.role: Common-mode RF suppression on the J1 pair and on W1, replacing the module's removed RFI network at tens of MHz and above
recommended_extras.listing_title: Mateda Ferrite Ring Core Ferrite Beads Clip RFI EMI Noise Suppressor Anti-Interference Cable Clip for 3.5mm/ 5mm/ 7mm/ 9mm/ 13mm Diameter Cable, Black (20)
recommended_extras.notes: Use the 5 mm cores. They do little near 1.92 MHz, where the RC filter provides the alias rejection.
